theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratio is the annual cost of managing your investment. Lower ratios mean more money stays invested for growth.
caption: Every mutual fund charges an expense ratio to cover operational costs. This percentage directly impacts your long-term returns. Know what you're paying before investing. #MutualFundBasics #InvestingEducation #ExpenseRatio #SmartInvesting #WealthGrowth
